digest.component_or_area: workflow pass-1 and escalation model resolution
propositions: Pass-1 ladder and escalation currently resolve to bare Anthropic model IDs when configured for other providers, causing split-brain failures in non-Anthropic environments
Model ladder entries (haiku/sonnet/opus) must be expressed as reserved class names rather than provider-specific model IDs and resolved via existing resolve_model_string function
Escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic names even for Bedrock primaries, causing silent cross-provider failures on context limits
MODEL_LADDER must remain unchanged (bare names + window tokens) with substring matching preserved for context budget calculations, while models_at_or_above maps resolved rungs through class config

Three separate batch runner call sites (production_batch_runner, code_review/batch_runner, workflow/runners) must each resolve class names in model_ladder before assignment, preventing unresolved string literals from reaching executors
Back-compat guarantee: when no classes are configured, class resolution returns bare names unchanged, preserving existing caller behavior and test assertions
